title: GOV-01 static acquisition private canonical-ledger verification v2 (draft)
description: Strict in-memory read-only projection of one complete persistent ledger.jsonl produced by the frozen executor. The content-addressed frozen executor semantic checker verifies exact raw UTF-8-NFC-LF bytes, no BOM/CR/duplicate key/float, canonical lines, shared challenge and receipt, contiguous sequence, nondecreasing time, every domain-separated HMAC, previous-HMAC chain, head, event state machine, and frozen closure constants. No separate evidence file is authorized. Absent, partial, noncanonical, or terminal-write-failed ledgers cannot instantiate the healthy projection and remain retained failures requiring new recovery authority.

projection_kind.const: read-only-complete-ledger-jsonl-projection; not a separately authorized persisted artifact

canonical_record_profile.const: each raw line is exactly UTF-8 NFC sorted-key compact JSON plus one LF; no BOM, CR, duplicate key, float, NaN, Infinity, blank line or trailing bytes

semantic_checker_profile.const: require all records share challenge and receipt_digest; sequence is zero-based contiguous; at_utc is nondecreasing; first previous_hmac_sha256 is 64 zeroes; every later previous_hmac_sha256 equals prior hmac_sha256; recompute each HMAC-SHA-256 over ASCII(CLS/GOV01/STATIC-ACQUISITION-LEDGER/v2) || NUL || uint64be(canonical-base-byte-length) || canonical base JSON excluding hmac_sha256; ledger_head_hmac_sha256 equals final record hmac_sha256; every repeated tree_sha256 is identical

pre_marker_stage.const: retain hidden 0700 stage without marker when failure occurs before incomplete marker creation

marker_present_stage.const: retain hidden 0700 stage and exact 0600 incomplete marker

marker_removed_stage.const: retain hidden 0755 sealed stage without marker when failure occurs after finalize_stage_marker and before rename

published_target.const: retain unauthorized published target and require user decision when rename succeeded but final attestation failed

hmac_key_id_profile.const: HMAC-SHA-256 with the authorized 32-byte private key over ASCII(CLS/GOV01/HMAC-KEY-ID/v2) || NUL || eight zero bytes

append_lock.const: exclusive challenge-directory ownership prevents a second same-challenge writer; one append fd is retained for the attempt; no fcntl claim

hash_chain_profile.const: HMAC-SHA-256 with 32-byte private key over ASCII(CLS/GOV01/STATIC-ACQUISITION-LEDGER/v2) || NUL || uint64be(canonical-event-base-byte-length) || UTF-8-NFC-LF canonical event-base JSON; each record stores previous_hmac_sha256 and hmac_sha256

public_output_channel.const: one locator-free canonical JSON object on stdout; stderr contains no private text

direct_sri_locator_profile.const: sha512 SRI bytes -> _cacache/content-v2/sha512/<first-2>/<next-2>/<remainder>; no index lookup

content_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01-OFFLINE-CACHE/v1) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is lexicographically sorted LF-terminated rows of exactly 6 TAB-separated columns: lock_key, version, resolved, integrity, compressed_bytes, actual_integrity

ustar_closure_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/USTAR-CLOSURE/v2) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is lexicographically sorted LF-terminated rows of exactly 13 TAB-separated columns: lock_key,version,integrity,compressed_bytes,tar_bytes,member_count,raw_regular_count,raw_directory_count,payload_bytes,strip_root,package_name,package_version,member_manifest_sha256; each member_manifest_sha256 is SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/USTAR-PACKAGE-MEMBERS/v2) || NUL || sorted LF-terminated 8-column rows: lock_path,member_index,kind,raw_path,stripped_or_dash,mode04o,size,digest)

resolution_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/NODE-RESOLUTION-CLOSURE/v2) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is lexicographically sorted LF-terminated rows of exactly 7 TAB-separated columns: source_or_<root>,edge_type,dep_name,spec,target_or_dash,target_version_or_dash,state

expected_tree_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/DETERMINISTIC-NODE-MODULES/v2) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is LF-terminated rows sorted by UTF-8 path bytes with exactly 5 TAB-separated columns: kind,path,mode04o,size,identity where identity is file SHA-256, relative symlink text, or dash for directory

module_import_policy.const: isolated -I -S -B interpreter, frozen stdlib tree and content-addressed executor/verifier source only; no persisted module trace under this authority

ctypes_policy.const: verifier may bind Darwin flistxattr; executor may bind only Darwin renameatx_np with RENAME_EXCL; no arbitrary dlopen or foreign symbol

private_evidence_retention.const: full projection remains in memory only and is not materialized under this authority

failed_stage_cleanup_mode.const: retain-in-place; no automatic deletion, cleanup, quarantine move or glob under this authority

public_export_allowed_fields.const: only the locator-free stdout fields admitted by the bound public-attestation schema; no repository file write
